# Clas Trading Co. / شركة كلاس التجارية
Children’s clothing wholesale business established in 2018. Own brands: Lamees, Top Clas, Baby 4 You. All brands cover newborn to 15 years. Adult garments occasionally available.
Office: Al-Balad, Bab Sharif, Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Saudi short address JACA6636.
Hours: Saturday–Thursday 10:00–20:00 Asia/Riyadh. Friday closed.
WhatsApp/phone: +966 55 310 0383. Email: clasintl676@gmail.com. Instagram: @clastradingco.
Wholesale only. Typical orders around 50 boxes or half a container; confirm the exact minimum and packing with the team. Pricing is private. No cart, payment or customer accounts.
Delivery across Saudi Arabia or collection from Jeddah. Walk-in sample visits without appointments during office hours. Confirm delivery timing and fees with quotation.
